name: backup
desc: Create a tar.gz backup with a JSON manifest (hashes, sizes), verify archives, and prune by retention

name: certgen
desc: Generate RSA/EC keys, CSRs and self-signed certificates via openssl, plus base64 one-liners for CSR submission

name: cronlab
desc: Explain/validate cron expressions in English, compute next run times, and convert between formats

name: deploycheck
desc: Run pre-deploy checks: env parity, secrets in repo, untracked files, build artifacts, git cleanliness

name: dockerclean
desc: Report dangling images, stopped containers, orphan volumes and build cache; emit a safe/aggressive cleanup plan

name: dotenvgen
desc: Produce .env/.env.example/.env.docker from a single schema file with secret generation and validation

name: envcheck
desc: Diff a .env against .env.example: find missing, extra, empty and duplicate keys (CI gate)

name: firewalldiff
desc: Dump iptables/nftables/ufw rules, flag dangerous accepts, and diff against a saved baseline
usage: node tools/firewalldiff.js --save baseline.json  |  node tools/firewalldiff.js --diff baseline.json

name: gitstats
desc: Repo stats: commits per author, churn per file, busiest hours, stale branches, TODO debt count

name: gru
desc: Audit /etc/passwd and /etc/group: UID 0 accounts, empty passwords, sudo membership, shell inventory, staleness

name: healthcheck
desc: Poll a URL until it returns expected status/body, with interval, retries and total-time budget

name: logparse
desc: Parse nginx/apache access logs: top IPs, paths, status mix, scanners, and attack signatures

name: nginxgen
desc: Generate production nginx server blocks: static, reverse proxy, websocket, PHP-FPM, redirect, TLS

name: pkgdiff
desc: Diff dependencies between two package.json/composer.json/lockfiles: added, removed, bumped, risky majors

name: portmap
desc: Map listening sockets to owning processes and flag unexpected public binds

name: sslrenew
desc: Check certificates for renewal, list the exact renewal commands, and land SNI hostname grouping

name: syssnap
desc: Collect CPU, memory, disk, load, uptime, top processes into one snapshot with a health verdict

name: wpconfig
desc: Audit wp-config.php + .htaccess: salts, debug flags, file edit, DB prefix, table_prefix, exposed backups
